# Andre Gerecke

> AI transformation leader with 16+ years in digital transformation. Leads AI strategy, enablement and delivery at RWE Renewables Europe & Australia (Senior Digital Transformation Manager, since October 2023).

## Profile
- Languages: German (native), English (C1), French (C1).
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andregerecke/
- GitHub: https://github.com/andregerecke
- CV (PDF): https://andregerecke.github.io/assets/Andre_Gerecke_CV_2026.pdf

## Leadership highlights
- Conceived the OPEA AI Strategy 2026; designed the 2027 AI Enablement and Scaling Concept (four-level maturity model, six-phase method, six-to-eight-week AI Value Waves) with a roadmap through 2029.
- Enabled 700+ colleagues through business-specific Copilot workshops and rapid prototyping; built a network of 28 AI Champions; developed an AI Prompting Framework.
- Co-organised a Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio hackathon with Microsoft (September 2026, ~50 business participants, five groups).
- Guided business teams from ideation to implemented AI agents, e.g. a Procurement Support Agent; contributed to NPV.OptimAIzer, an AI lighthouse for wind project-value optimisation.

## Selected use cases (reported, estimated per use case)
- Marge, market expert (Procurement): €200k–500k better negotiation results, ~30 days saved, 15% time reduction.
- Contract Validator (Real Estate Accounting): ~33% less validation time, 43 days saved.
- Typo (Development IT): 75% time reduction, ~29 days saved.
